proof_body:
by
  intro n s hn hs
  have hn' : (0 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hc : (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) n).card < s.card := by
    simpa using hs
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, h⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (f := fun x : ℤ => x % (n : ℤ)) hc (by
    intro x _
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨Int.emod_nonneg x hn'.ne', Int.emod_lt_of_pos x hn'⟩))
  exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, Int.ModEq.dvd (Eq.symm h)⟩
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Finset ℤ), 0 < n → n < s.card → ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ b ∈ s, a ≠ b ∧ (n : ℤ) ∣ a - b
